svg.text: J1 pin numbers TBD until docs/signals.md is continuity-verified — signal CLASSES are fixed, pin ORDER is not. Head element count (7) is unverified.
* populate only if a separate paper-feed motor / paper-out sensor exists (Phase 0 Decision 2). USB enumerates as CDC serial.
R40 0.1Ω shunt + RC filter (Option B only)
internal — gates U2, not a J1 signal
J3-1 +5V ──F2 500mA──► Pico VSYS, U2/U6 VCC, U3/U4 VCC, sensor pull-ups
3V3 (Pico out) ──► U5 VCC, R30/R31 pull-ups (U5 at 3V3 so GP9 can trigger it)
J3-3 VMOT (voltage TBD) ──F1 2A──► head elements + ULN COM ── C7 470µF bulk
GND star point at power entry; logic GND and VMOT return meet only there
J1 power pins (count/order TBD): +5V, VMOT, multiple GND
Thermal head elements — count TBD; 10k pulldowns mandatory
